about.metadataTitle: About Comrade Sovia — Music, Art & Storytelling
about.metadataDescription: Discover Comrade Sovia, an independent music and visual art project by Mikazuki Runa, its Soviet-inspired arrangements and fictional radio world.
about.title: About Comrade Sovia
about.lead: Comrade Sovia is an independent music and visual art project created by Mikazuki Runa. It reinterprets music from different cultures and eras through Soviet-inspired arrangements, visual aesthetics, and fictional storytelling.
worldParagraphs: At the center of the project is Sovia Rabocheva (Совия Ивановна Рабочева), an original fictional character who works as a radio broadcaster in the Soviet scientific town of Troitsk.

In Sovia’s fictional universe, an unusual phenomenon allows music from other worlds to reach her radio station. She collects these unfamiliar melodies and reinterprets them through the musical traditions of her own world, sharing them with listeners through her broadcasts.
directionParagraphs: The project’s music draws inspiration from Soviet orchestral arrangements, choral traditions, folk music, vintage recordings, and theatrical performances. Its visual identity combines Soviet-era design influences with anime-inspired character art.

Comrade Sovia blends musical experimentation, creative reinterpretation, fictional worldbuilding, humor, and occasional satire. It is an independent artistic project rather than a historical reconstruction or a representation of any political organization.
about.distinction: Comrade Sovia is the project. Mikazuki Runa is its real-world creator. Sovia Rabocheva is a fictional character within its story.

creator.metadataTitle: Mikazuki Runa — Creator of Comrade Sovia
creator.metadataDescription: Meet Mikazuki Runa, the Germany-based independent creator of Comrade Sovia, and learn how music, visual art and fiction come together in the project.
creator.title: Mikazuki Runa
creator.lead: Mikazuki Runa is the stage name of an independent creator based in Germany and the creator of Comrade Sovia.
paragraphs: With a personal passion for singing and music, Runa enjoys exploring different musical styles, cultures, and approaches to creative expression.
Through Comrade Sovia, Runa combines interests in music, visual art, fictional characters, and storytelling to create reinterpretations of familiar songs within an original fictional universe.
Runa designed Sovia Rabocheva as the project’s central character, giving the music a fictional voice and a world of its own.
The project is an ongoing personal creative experiment, bringing together musical ideas, digital production tools, and visual storytelling.
creator.distinction: Mikazuki Runa is the real-world creator; Sovia Rabocheva is a fictional character.

worldTypes: 0 is the reference point: Sovia’s original world, home to the interdimensional broadcast station. All polarization readings are taken relative to this origin.

Along the positive real axis, a larger value marks a greater departure from Sovia’s original world and its established setting. Near 1, the character is almost entirely original. This direction includes official and fan-created original characters.
The negative real axis points toward other fictional works. At -1, the character comes entirely from another work; its origin belongs to that work’s world.

Along the +i direction, a reading closer to 1i places the world of origin closer to the audience’s real world. The nearer it is to that boundary, the clearer the traces of reality in its origins. This reading describes origin; identity is recorded in the character’s profile.

The negative imaginary axis leads into the historical record. At -1i, the arrival retains a fully faithful historical portrayal: a passage from actual history into Sovia’s world, recorded as fully historical time travel.

reading.title: Notes from the interdimensional observatory
reading.introduction: The broadcast station marks Sovia’s original world as 0. Every arrival leaves a trace on this chart: its direction points toward the world it came from, while its value records how far its origins depart from the station’s own world.
reading.note: The +i direction describes a world of origin. A character’s identity is recorded separately in their profile.
